one which you currently don't have.
"BREAK AREA  -  Employees only, no visitors or guests allowed
NO CHILDREN!  If you must bring your kid to work, you may NOT leave them here!  We are not legally qualified to care for juveniles in our break areas!
Food and drink is allowed and available in this area.  ALL employees MUST wash their hands before entering and before returning to work.
Personal phone service in this area.  Long-distance service available via your employee account and ID card."
Double arrows towards the elevator indicate passage of forklifts and heavy cargo to go on elevators on this level.
Double arrows away from the elevator signify forklifts and heavy cargo from another floor come out of such elevators.
Arrows in both directions mean small cargo carried by persons, and people themselves, go in and out of such elevators."
"Open this chest!  We can use these!  You have my permission."
Taro does something next that he doesn't usually do.  Its something you aren't expecting, either.
Taro SMILES.  He smiles and gestures with his hand, away from the opening to where there are large amounts of
gleaming, precious metals inside the caged-in area.
"PLEASE gentlepersons, good and trustworthy companions - Please do not go into there where you need not bother investigating the monster
invasion.  We keep many precious metals there, as you can see, and they look just fine, no inspection is needed, thank you.
Why don't we check out the offices, or other areas, please?"
"Aw, but can't we just - you know - admire the stuff up close for a few moments, and look at how pretty it is?"
With a long, LOUD metallic "shwiiiiing" Taro draws his katana as his smile disappears, and he gestures at \P[4] with
his katana sword, as well as at parts of the warehouse walls and floor as he speaks.
"Well MAYBE I can blade-spank your smartmouth butt all up and down this warehouse floor, and ADMIRE how pretty
the floor looks washed with your blood, buddy!"
Taro dances his eyebrows up and down.
"Okay now THAT type of talk I DO understand, sir!  Um...  Shit..."
"Dude will you shut up!?  We're working with this guy and shouldn't piss him off!"
"YOU shut up \P[1]!  You're making me look stupid!"
"Guys!  We're all looking pretty dumb right now!"
"Children, BEHAVE.  We're sorry Taro, we won't distrub any of your town's gold or silver, and my friend was just joking."
\P[2] grabs you by the arm and \P[4] by his EAR of all things, and walks you both out of the opening in the fence.
